text.description_html:
Omnia 442, Replacement Half-Round Door Knob and Rosette

Simple in design, this Omnia made door knob is both elegant and timeless. What is best about this 2-1/8" diameter knob is that it will never go out of style--a simple classic with a durable solid brass interior, it will look beautiful no matter how many times you change the room's decor around it. The Half-Round Simple Knob is a replacement set. It comes packaged with the knob and rose only and does not include a spindle or latch.

Specifications for the Omnia 442 Simple Replacement Knob and Rosette:

  • Knob Diameter: 2-1/8"
  • Knob Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"

Special Ordered Item. No Returns.
